newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Prisco to decide on capital rise.
newsitem.headline: Prisco to decide on capital rise.

text.p: Shareholders of Russian shipping company Prisco will vote by the end of next month on whether to raise the company's capital 1,250-fold by redenominating shares, a Prisco official said on Thursday.

Vadim Moiseyev, an official from the company's securities department, told Reuters that shareholders would vote on a proposal to raise authorised capital to 553.05 billion roubles from 442.44 million.

The vote will be taken by post. Ballots, mailed to shareholders on the register as of September 18, must be returned by October 25 to be valid, and AOOT Primorskoye Morskoye Parokhodstvo (PMP in Russian, or Prisco) will announce the results on October 28.

Moiseyev said the Prisco board was proposing the capital increase to reflect an increase in the value of its fixed assets. Shares would be redenominated at 25,000 roubles face value instead of 20 roubles.

Moiseyev said that officials from CS First Boston, Pioneer Group, Flemings, Merrill Lynch, Troika Dialog and Alfa-Capital finance companies approved the proposal during a meeting with Prisco's board in Moscow on September 11.
Prisco has not traded recently on the Russian Trading System but was quoted on Thursday with a wide spread of $1.00/$2.90.
